aggressive_definition_excerpt: We investigated the association between dietary GI, GL, II, fiber, and whole grains and risk of total prostate cancer (n = 5,112) and subgroups of prostate cancer as defined by stage or grade in 49,934 male participants of the Health Professionals Follow-up Study.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We investigated the association between dietary GI, GL, II, fiber, and whole grains and risk of total prostate cancer (n = 5,112) and subgroups of prostate cancer as defined by stage or grade in 49,934 male participants of the Health Professionals Follow-up Study.
reason: The abstract analyzes total incident prostate cancer. It mentions subgroups defined by stage or grade but does not explicitly identify an advanced, high-grade, aggressive, metastatic, high-risk, or lethal stratum; generic stage/grade stratification does not establish aggressive incidence.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: We observed a positive association between dietary intake of whole grains and total prostate cancer (HR highest versus lowest quintile 1.13, 95% CI 1.03-1.24), which was attenuated after restriction to PSA-screened participants (HR 1.03, 95% CI 0.91-1.17).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate explicitly concerns total prostate cancer and therefore is a general incident prostate cancer estimate.
